# Part 03 · Chinchilla Scaling Laws

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcMkA1qRxRH/) · Published 18 Aug 2026

> With a fixed compute budget, do you make the model bigger or feed it more data?

Gopher had 280B parameters trained on 300B tokens. Chinchilla, 70B parameters on 1.4T tokens, beat it on the same compute budget.

## The idea

- Parameters and training tokens should grow together.
- Compute-optimal is roughly 20 training tokens per parameter.
- The smaller, longer-trained model is also cheaper to serve on every request.

## The formula

$$
C \approx 6ND, \quad D \approx 20N
$$
